decisions.reason: High home-page visibility and centrality imply strong public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
Dedicated page and positive adoption result signal both commitment and success, making drop very unlikely.
Lower visibility and no notable results weaken commitment, but sunk investment and ongoing relevance still favor keeping.
As a low-investment feature close to the established offer with only a website mention, weak commitment and lack of results make dropping likely.
Security relevance and building on the established offer provide moderate commitment, so keeping is more likely.
